PROP-57888860-inv-002.text: Batch KZG verification pairing equation must hold: e(LL, LR) == e(RL, G2) for valid proofs.
PROP-57888860-inv-002.assertion: forall valid(cells, proofs, comms): pairing_check([[g1_lincomb(proofs, r_powers), KZG_SETUP_G2_MONOMIAL[n]], [RL, neg(G2)]]) == true

locations.note: Computes pairing check: multi_pairings(&[(random_sum_proofs, tau_pow_n), (pairing_input_g1, neg_g2_gen)]) where pairing_input_g1 = (random_sum_commitments - comm_random_sum_interpolation_poly) + random_weighted_sum_proofs
